x: To see Tommy Heenan, our masseur, racing up the straight in civvies, with Curwen in his training, was a delight as well as an honour for the fortunate witnesses. Tommy was a fast man in the days of Jack Butler, Larner and Sturgess. Some members have entered events lately in the names of other clubs.
Also competed:- Morrison, Hampshire, Yeo, Startup, Rendle, Finn, Satchell, Sturgess, Crosbie, Pearce, Williams, Dawson.
